name: Tetris: Dubble Bubble Edition (FT. Diet Dew)
author: heithgladding
description: Tetris was one of my favorite games growing up so decide to try and build my own but with Double Bubble as the blocks. Also added a 8th block to the normal seven that everybody is used to. This block is the H Block and it makes the game a lot harder (Probably why its not in real tetris). Music-Creative Minds by Bensound (https://www.bensound.com/royalty-free-music/track/creative-minds). 2 images were taken from online to use in this game. Dubble Bubble Image - ( https://www.economycandy.com/product/original-dubble-bubble-gum/?attribute_pa_buying-options=per-pound&gclid=Cj0KCQiAk53-BRD0ARIsAJuNhpsHFRC298mrrGJnw88settdzW9rALHfg1eHP_kgsxlBS1IwCCm9RBgaAiivEALw_wcB ).
